Declarations and Undertakings for Selecting a Government-Developed Home Against a Housing Loan
I hereby acknowledge that I am aware of and agree to the following selection terms:
First: Selecting a Home within a Government Project at a Price Not Exceeding the Approved Loan Amount, with No Additional Amount Payable by the Beneficiary
I acknowledge that I am entitled to two opportunities to select a home. During the first opportunity, I must confirm my selection within no more than seven (7) days from the date the selection invitation is sent.
If I do not confirm my selection within the specified period, or if I cancel my selection, I will be given a second opportunity. I must confirm my selection within seven (7) days from the date the second selection invitation is sent.
If I do not confirm my selection within either specified period, or if I cancel my selection, my selection will be cancelled. The Abu Dhabi Housing Authority may exclude me from the selected project or take any other action it considers appropriate in accordance with its approved regulations and procedures.
Second: Selecting a Home within a Government Project at a Price Exceeding the Approved Loan Amount, with an Additional Amount Payable by the Beneficiary
I acknowledge that I am entitled to two opportunities to select a home. During the first opportunity, I must confirm my selection within seven (7) days from the date the selection invitation is sent.
I must pay the additional amount within a maximum of three (3) months from the date the selection is confirmed, in accordance with the approved payment method.
If I do not confirm my selection, fail to pay the additional amount within a maximum of three (3) months from the date the selection is confirmed, or cancel my selection, I will be given a second opportunity. I must confirm my selection within seven (7) days from the date the second selection invitation is sent.
For the second opportunity, I must pay the additional amount within a maximum of three (3) months from the date the selection is confirmed, in accordance with the approved payment method.
I further acknowledge that the final approval process and any subsequent procedures will not be completed until the additional amount has been paid in full within a maximum of three (3) months from the date the selection is confirmed.
If I do not confirm my selection or fail to pay the additional amount within a maximum of three (3) months from the date the selection is confirmed, my selection will be cancelled. The Abu Dhabi Housing Authority may exclude me from the selected project or take any other action it considers appropriate in accordance with its approved regulations and procedures.
Third: Restriction on Disposal of the Existing Housing Grant, if Applicable
I acknowledge that a restriction preventing the disposal of my existing housing grant, if any, will be imposed immediately upon my receipt of the invitation to select a home. I will not be entitled to use or benefit from any advantages arising from that grant, in accordance with the Authority’s approved regulations and procedures.
Fourth: Relinquishment
I agree to relinquish any residential land or home previously granted to me to the Abu Dhabi Housing Authority or to any entity designated by it immediately upon confirming my selection of the home, whether the selected home is completed or part of a future off-plan project. This relinquishment is final and irrevocable under all circumstances.
Fifth: Powers of the Authority
I acknowledge the Authority’s right to cancel the approval issued for the selected housing unit if I fail to complete the final approval procedures within the specified periods. Such cancellation will not give rise to any future right to claim or object.
